data.name: Swara
data.gender_notes: Swara is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Swara is a Sanskrit word meaning 'sound' or 'melody'. In Hindu mythology, Swara is associated with the divine melodies created by gods during the creation of the universe. The word is also used to describe the seven fundamental musical notes in Indian classical music. The name Swara carries the meaning “Sound, Melody” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Swara usually hope their child will grow to embody sound, melody and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbol of divine harmony and melodious creation

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Swara total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
